answer: Biometric Hardware Enclave Attestation. Operators must cryptographically bind each autonomous agent identity to a unique physical device holding an embedded ferrous secure element. The system uses a sonnet verification challenge to prove the enclave executes code without hypervisor tampering. An attacker scaling sybil agents pays a severe operational cost: purchasing distinct physical hardware units for every single identity, neutralizing software-only replication entirely. The system archives the validation state on an onyx ledger to prevent replay exploits.
